citation: Everitt, T.A., Jennings, J.W. & Gault, R.H. (1992). Diagnostic Analysis of Sucker Rod Pumping Systems. SPE-24838.

cards.name: Normal Operation
cards.description: Full pump fillage, standard elastic rod stretch, good valve action.
cards.recommended_action: Maintain optimal SPM and stroke length.

cards.name: Fluid Pound
cards.description: Incomplete pump fillage (50%). Plunger impacts liquid surface mid-downstroke generating severe stress shockwaves.
cards.recommended_action: Reduce SPM or initiate pump-off control (POC) idle cycle.

cards.name: Gas Interference
cards.description: Free gas entering pump barrel causes polytropic compression cushion without mechanical shock impact.
cards.recommended_action: Increase intake submergence, lower pump intake, or optimize casing-head gas venting.

cards.name: Severe Rod Floating
cards.description: Heavy viscous drag exceeds buoyant rod weight. Polished rod floats on downstroke, uncoupling from carrier bar with BDC impact slap.
cards.recommended_action: Activate VFD asymmetric downstroke ratio (0.60), reduce SPM, or circulate hot diluent.

cards.name: Parted Sucker Rod
cards.description: Sucker rod string fractured downhole. Load card collapses to low horizontal baseline with no fluid lift.
cards.recommended_action: Trigger emergency shutdown. Dispatch workover rig for rod fishing and replacement.

cards.name: Traveling Valve Leak
cards.description: Plunger traveling ball and seat leakage causing delayed upstroke pressurization and lost pump displacement.
cards.recommended_action: Perform traveling valve leak check test; schedule valve cage inspection.

cards.name: Standing Valve Leak
cards.description: Standing valve ball/seat failure allows barrel fluid to leak back into reservoir during downstroke.
cards.recommended_action: Perform stationary standing valve leak test; replace pump bottom assembly.

cards.name: Unanchored Tubing Movement
cards.description: Tubing string stretches and buckles cyclically under alternating hydrostatic load, tilting the dynacard loop.
cards.recommended_action: Install downhole tubing anchor catcher (TAC) to eliminate lost stroke.

cards.name: Worn Pump Barrel
cards.description: Barrel wear near mid-stroke causes slippage and tapered load loss.
cards.recommended_action: Review Worn Pump Barrel diagnostic protocol and apply remedial parameters.

cards.name: Excessive Polished Rod Friction
cards.description: Over-tightened stuffing box packing adds uniform friction band.
cards.recommended_action: Review Excessive Polished Rod Friction diagnostic protocol and apply remedial parameters.

cards.name: Mechanical Bottom Tagging
cards.description: Plunger contacts standing valve cage at bottom dead center with shock spike.
cards.recommended_action: Review Mechanical Bottom Tagging diagnostic protocol and apply remedial parameters.

cards.name: Mechanical Top Tagging
cards.description: Plunger hits upper guide or tubing stop at top of stroke.
cards.recommended_action: Review Mechanical Top Tagging diagnostic protocol and apply remedial parameters.

cards.name: Delayed Standing Valve Closure
cards.description: Debris or high-viscosity viscous delay in ball reseating.
cards.recommended_action: Review Delayed Standing Valve Closure diagnostic protocol and apply remedial parameters.

cards.name: Deep Fillage Deficit (Over-Pumping)
cards.description: Well capacity exhausted; severe pump starvation under 40% fillage.
cards.recommended_action: Review Deep Fillage Deficit (Over-Pumping) diagnostic protocol and apply remedial parameters.

cards.name: Overloaded Rod String (Fatigue Danger)
cards.description: Peak polished rod load exceeds 95% of modified Goodman stress limit.
cards.recommended_action: Review Overloaded Rod String (Fatigue Danger) diagnostic protocol and apply remedial parameters.

cards.name: High Viscous Drag with Stabilized Float
cards.description: Viscous boundary layer creates high hysteresis loop without complete uncoupling.
cards.recommended_action: Review High Viscous Drag with Stabilized Float diagnostic protocol and apply remedial parameters.
